delivered.body: Share Purchase Agreement PARTIES. This Agreement is between the Seller and Meridian Acquisitions LLC as Buyer. 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The Buyer shall pay the Seller a total Purchase Price of USD 47,000,000 for the Shares, subject to adjustment as mutually agreed. 2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur within thirty days of signing. 3. REPRESENTATIONS. The Seller represents that the financial statements are accurate. 4. INDEMNITY. The Seller indemnifies the Buyer against undisclosed liabilities.
